payload.description_html: Doolysaurus is a thescelosaurid dinosaur known only from a single juvenile individual. Thescelosaurids were relatively basal bipedal ornithischians, that reached small to medium size. As it is known only from an juvenile specimen, the adult size of Doolysaurus is difficult to estimate, though it likely didn't exceed 3 m in total body length.
